# Curriculum Vitae & Resume Documents

This directory is reserved for your official CV and Resume PDF documents.

## Expected File Paths

- **Curriculum Vitae (Academic / Comprehensive)**:
  `assets/docs/cv.pdf`
- **Resume (Professional / Industry Summary)**:
  `assets/docs/resume.pdf`

## How It Works

1. Export your CV as a PDF file and save it as `cv.pdf` directly inside this directory (`assets/docs/cv.pdf`).
2. Export your Resume as a PDF file and save it as `resume.pdf` directly inside this directory (`assets/docs/resume.pdf`).
3. Commit and push the files to your repository.

The portfolio website contains pre-configured links that automatically point to `assets/docs/cv.pdf` and `assets/docs/resume.pdf`. Once the files are placed in this folder, users clicking the "Download CV" or "Download Resume" buttons can view and download them immediately.
